title: Agent launch settings
description: Portable model defaults for coding-agent-sandbox sessions.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema used by editor validation and completion.

model.description: Model name passed directly to the selected agent CLI. A recognized ":<effort>" suffix sets "effort" instead of becoming part of the name.

effort.description: Default reasoning effort. Ignored by agents whose CLI has no equivalent flag.

models.description: Models offered by integrations such as a model picker, one entry per model.

modelChoice.description: A selectable model: either a bare name, or a name with per-model options.

anyOf.description: Shorthand for an entry with no options beyond its name.

name.description: Model name passed directly to the selected agent CLI.

label.description: Display name shown by a picker instead of the raw model name.

efforts.description: Reasoning efforts this model may be run with, offered alongside it by a picker.

effort.description: Reasoning effort selected with this model by default.
How much reasoning the model should spend before answering.
